extra.final_summary:
Average bill length (mm) by island for Adelie penguins: Biscoe 38.8, Dream 37.43, Torgersen 39.39 (20 Adelie rows used).

Fixes applied: (1) merged island label variants " Biscoe" and "Biscoe " into "Biscoe" (3 cells); (2) removed 2 exact duplicate rows (rows 7 and 11).

Caveats: the question only depends on species, island, and bill_length_mm, all of which are clean. Other columns have issues I did not touch: flipper_length_mm has a negative value (-187, row 21) outside the allowed 170–235 range, and body_mass_g has implausible values (e.g., 3,800,000 g in rows 1 and 4) outside the 2500–6500 g range. These don't affect this answer but should be reviewed.
